title: QC Analyst - Audio Content - Brazil
description:
Nova vaga disponível para QC Analyst - Audio Content - Brazil em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

About Us  Pocket FM is the world’s largest audio-series platform, where powerful stories travel effortlessly across languages, cultures, and continents. From India and the US to Europe and beyond, we are redefining how stories are created, discovered, and experienced across the globe, without screens. At our core, we are an AI-powered entertainment company with a deeply human-first philosophy. We believe technology should amplify creativity. Our proprietary AI systems work alongside writers, voice artists, and creative teams to help stories scale globally, faster, smarter, and with cultural depth and emotional integrity intact. Today, Pocket FM is home to a vibrant community of 250+ million listeners, 300,000+ creators, and 100,000+ audio series. With over 140 billion minutes streamed annually, we have emerged as one of the fastest-growing media-tech companies in the world, and we are just getting started. We operate at a massive global scale, but with a startup mindset: curious, fast-moving, and deeply owner-driven. At Pocket FM, teams are encouraged to think boldly, move with intent, and build for long-term impact as we shape the future of audio-first storytelling worldwide. Role Overview  As a QC Analyst - Audio Content, you will be responsible for reviewing and ensuring the quality, accuracy, and consistency of audio files across different stages of production. This includes raw voice files submitted by voice-over artists and mastered audio files (with SFX and music) delivered by agencies. You will work closely with voice artists, agencies, and internal teams to ensure all audio content aligns with scripts, quality guidelines, and storytelling objectives. Key Responsibilities  1. Audio Quality Control (Raw & Mastered Files)  Review raw voice-over recordings to ensure clarity, acting, delivery, pronunciation, tone, pacing, and adherence to script. Evaluate mastered audio files (SFX + background music) for overall listening experience, sound ambiences, balance, and quality standards. Ensure all audio assets meet defined QC guidelines and Specs before approval.  2. Script-to-Audio Alignment  Verify that audio delivery accurately follows the approved script, including dialogue, tone, and emotional expression. Identify and flag mismatches, missing lines, or deviations in narration.  3. Technical & Creative Accuracy  Check audio for: Voice clarity and consistency Emotional delivery and storytelling effectiveness Background noise or distortions Timing and pacing issues Proper integration of SFX and music in mastered files Grammatically incorrect words/sentences Physical noise of voice artist Abrupt cut / jerk Sibilance Fumble / mumble  4. Vendor & Artist Coordination  Collaborate with voice-over artists and external agencies to communicate QC feedback.  Ensure timely implementation of revisions and re-submissions.  5. QC Documentation & Tracking  Provide detailed QC feedback at timecode (TC) level. Update QC comments and statuses in internal tools or Excel trackers based on show type (AI and PGC content). Maintain records for submissions, revisions, approvals, and delivery timelines.  6. Pre-Release Quality Checks  Ensure all audio files are QC-approved before publishing or release on the platform. Validate that final output meets both technical and creative standards.  7. Cross-Team Collaboration  Work closely with writers, production teams, post production agencies, and content managers to ensure seamless audio quality. Align with internal guidelines and storytelling expectations across shows.  8. Process Improvement  Identify recurring audio quality issues across voice artists or agencies. Recommend improvements to QC processes, guidelines, and production workflows. Understand how an audience reacts to certain genres of content to connect with the audience Stay abreast with changes in the voice requirements and technology  9. Volume & Deadline Management  Handle QC for approximately 80 hours of audio content  within defined timelines. Maintain high-quality standards while managing large volumes of content.  10. AI Voice Quality Review & Enhancement  Review AI-generated voice content to identify issues impacting listener experience, including but not limited to: Accent inconsistencies and unnatural speech patterns Mispronunciations and incorrect word stress Lack of emotion, expression, or character differentiation Robotic delivery, pacing irregularities, or unnatural pauses Voice continuity and tonal inconsistencies across episodes Contextually inappropriate emphasis or dialogue delivery  Perform basic audio patchwork and corrective edits using approved audio editing tools to address identified issues wherever feasible. Document AI voice-related observations with clear, actionable feedback at the time-code level and track recurring issues to support model improvements and production quality enhancements. Collaborate with AI production, content, and post-production teams to ensure continuous improvement in AI-generated audio quality and listener engagement. Qualifications  Bachelor’s degree in Audio Engineering, Media, Communications, or a related field. Strong understanding of audio production, voice modulation, and sound design basics. Experience in audio quality control, podcast production, or voice-over review is preferred. Familiarity with audio editing tools (Audition, Audacity, or similar) is a plus. Ability to review both AI-generated and professionally generated (PGC) content. Excellent attention to detail and auditory judgment. Strong organizational and documentation skills. Ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced production environment. Proficiency in audio editing tools such as Adobe Audition, Audacity, or similar software for basic audio corrections and patchwork.  Language requirements  Fluent Portugese Professional working proficiency in English  This role will be working with stakeholders in English on a regular basis. Salary for this position is R$ $3800 - $4100 BRL.

title: Solutions Architect
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Solutions Architect em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

At Sisense, we help organizations turn complex data into actionable intelligence. As a Senior Solution Architect, you will play a critical role in designing, implementing, and optimizing enterprise-grade analytics deployments for customers with complex technical and business needs. You will partner closely with customers, internal stakeholders, and product teams to ensure successful outcomes across architecture, deployment, scalability, and long-term value realization. Employment Type : Full-time position employed by a partner agency (3rd party, B2B)  WHY JOIN OUR SOLUTION ARCHITECT TEAM?  You will work at the intersection of customer success, cloud architecture, and data platforms. You will help customers solve complex infrastructure, deployment, and performance challenges across Sisense environments. You will collaborate with Product, R&D, Support, and Customer Success to shape best practices and improve the platform. You will influence architecture decisions for strategic customers and high-visibility engagements.  IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL:  Lead custom multi-node Linux installations and upgrades for Sisense deployments, including troubleshooting complex deployment issues. Own and troubleshoot multi-node Windows-to-Linux migration projects, backup and restore processes, and architecture-related escalations. Perform load testing, interpret results, and provide strategic recommendations for scaling, performance, and resource optimization. Analyze logs, system performance, and infrastructure telemetry to proactively identify risks and optimize customer environments. Partner with customer Application Developers, DevOps, IT teams, and executive sponsors to drive successful outcomes. Act as the voice of the customer by sharing product feedback, submitting bugs and feature requests, and influencing roadmap priorities. Lead enablement for internal teams, mentor Solution Architects, and support technical interviews for new hires.  WHAT YOU’VE ACCOMPLISHED… SO FAR:  5+ years of related experience in customer-facing technical roles, with prior experience as a Solution Architect. Hands-on expertise with Linux (Ubuntu, Amazon Linux, RHEL/CentOS), Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, and cloud platforms such as AWS EKS / GKE. Strong experience troubleshooting distributed systems, networking, security, and system monitoring tools such as Grafana and Coralogix. Advanced working knowledge of MongoDB (or another NoSQL database), including query optimization and troubleshooting. Intermediate SQL skills with the ability to join data across disparate sources and optimize queries. Proficiency in scripting and coding with Bash, Python, JavaScript, and CSS. Experience with load testing tools such as K6 and with modern cloud data warehouse technologies (Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery) is a plus. Strong customer communication skills, with the ability to engage technical teams and executive stakeholders.  HOW YOU’LL RAMP:  By Day 30: Build a strong understanding of Sisense architecture, deployment models, product capabilities, and customer engagement processes. By Day 60: Independently lead standard and custom deployment activities, troubleshoot escalations, and support customer architecture reviews. By Day 90: Own complex technical engagements end-to-end, mentor junior team members, and contribute to internal best practices and enablement.

title: Lead Product Designer
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Lead Product Designer em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Who are we?  Transcenda, headquartered in the US, was founded in July 2019 and is a full-lifecycle product development company. With locations throughout Romania, Poland, Ukraine, and Brazil, Transcenda works with Fortune 500 companies and well-funded startups to help bring new products to life. Transcenda helps companies ideate new product concepts, build prototypes, design world-class solutions then engineer new commercial products. Transcenda puts people first and strives to be a changemaker by building a better world through technology. Transcenda has grown from a 5-person team to over 250 people over the past four years and plans to continue growing. About the role  This is a senior, consultancy-style design role. You'll move between leading projects end-to-end — driving discovery, aligning stakeholders, shaping direction — and rolling up your sleeves as a senior-level individual contributor when that's what the work needs. You'll be working on mature, live products where the bar is improving what exists: smoothing workflows, sharpening hierarchy, lifting conversion, and removing friction. This is not a greenfield, portfolio-piece role. If you get satisfaction from making a working product noticeably better for the people who use it every day, you'll like it here. Key responsibilities  Take ownership of design problems on assigned projects — frame the problem, drive it through discovery, design, and delivery, and bring stakeholders along the whole way. Lead or contribute on a project depending on what's needed — sometimes you're directing the design effort, sometimes you're the one in Figma producing the work. Both modes should feel comfortable. Partner closely with product managers and engineers, translating ambiguous requirements into concrete, testable design solutions and iterating against live implementations. Run the iterative cycle from low-fidelity exploration through high-fidelity delivery, with usability validation at the points where it actually changes the outcome. Facilitate workshops, design reviews, and working sessions with cross-functional and executive stakeholders. Make decisions visible and trade-offs explicit. Mentor and raise the bar for designers around you. Build durable relationships with stakeholders. Understand what they're actually trying to achieve and push back constructively when the brief is wrong.  Must haves  6–10+ years of UX/Product Design experience, ideally including time in a consultancy, agency, or embedded-team setting where you've owned client or stakeholder relationships directly. Demonstrated ability to flex between leading a project (or a small team) and contributing as a senior IC, depending on what the engagement needs. Track record of improving existing products rather than designing greenfield experiences — measurable wins on usability, conversion, or workflow efficiency. Strong visual and UI judgment for forms, workflows, CTAs, hierarchy, and layout. You can defend a layout decision on the merits. Comfort working closely with engineering against live implementations — you can read a real interface and tell us what's wrong with it before opening Figma. Ability to articulate why a design decision was made and what problem it solves, to audiences ranging from engineers to executives. Experience facilitating cross-functional workshops and leading business reviews or strategic planning sessions with senior stakeholders.  Nice to have  Background designing for regulated or enterprise domains (finance, compliance, GRC, banking, or similar). Experience designing software embedded inside third-party platforms. Familiarity with mature component libraries and design systems (MUI or similar). Experience mentoring or leveling up other designers through example and critique. Working knowledge of HTML/CSS; JavaScript a plus. Degree in Design, HCI, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent experience.  Please submit your application with an English-language CV/resume and a portfolio showcasing relevant work samples.

title: Analista de Projetos Pleno - Inglês Avançado
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Analista de Projetos Pleno - Inglês Avançado em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Estamos buscando uma pessoa Analist de Projetos/Delivery Operations Analyst para coordenar a operação ponta-a-ponta do nosso portfólio de projetos e iniciativas estratégicas de tecnologia. Você será responsável por garantir que projetos saiam do conceito, passem por discovery, atravessem ciclos de sprint e cheguem em produção com qualidade, previsibilidade e visibilidade total para o negócio. Trabalhará lado-a-lado com executivos, PO, Solution Architect, Designer e time de desenvolvimento, operando um modelo híbrido Water-Scrum-Fall com cadência de sprints quinzenais. É uma oportunidade para nos ajudar a desenhar e construir nosso processo de delivery, tendo voz ativa na evolução dele. Terá contato direto com a liderança, decisões rápidas e espaço real para impacto. Buscamos uma pessoa organizada e orientada a entrega e com excelente comunicação. Formato: 100% home office.  Necessário Inglês B2/C1 - Terá contato diário com times internacionais  Atuará no fuso horário -2h/-1h em relação ao horário de Brasília/DF  uais serão suas responsabilidades?  Governança e cadência de delivery Orientar a operação do portfólio de projetos (discovery, build, sprints, releases, go-live, closure). Garantir o cumprimento dos gates formais do processo (Sign-Off de requisitos, transição Water→Agile, aprovação de Go-Live, encerramento). Conduzir as cerimônias do ciclo de sprint: Daily Standup, Sprint Review com Retrospectiva, Pre-Planning de capacity e Planning. Manter cronogramas, dependências e owners atualizados; identificar e escalar riscos, gargalos e desvios proativamente. Identificar quando uma Release está pronta para War Room e disparar o processo de validação integrada. Coordenar UATs com Key Users e PO; garantir que bugs de UAT entrem no fluxo regular da próxima sprint. Coordenar o Go-Live em ambiente de produção em parceria com SA e PO. Liderar Hypercare pós Go-Live (2-4 semanas) e a transição formal para modo manutenção. Conduzir Project Closure: métricas finais, lessons learned, comunicação executiva. Conduzir a reunião semanal de Projects Follow-up com a liderança de TI, chegando com dashboard atualizado e propostas para riscos/decisões pendentes Definir, manter e evoluir KPIs de delivery (velocity, % done, prazo realizado vs planejado, bugs em produção, SLA de hypercare) Produzir status reports executivos para sponsors e stakeholders de negócio Garantir comunicação clara, constante e estruturada entre TI e business  O que esperamos que você possua?  Experiência prévia coordenando projetos de tecnologia, squads ou times de delivery Experiência prática com Scrum/Agile e com modelos híbridos/Waterfall Experiência operacional com Jira (boards, workflows, relatórios) ou ferramenta equivalente Excel intermediário a avançado (fórmulas, tabelas dinâmicas, dashboards) Experiência produzindo reportes executivos e apresentações em PowerPoint Experiência acompanhando KPIs e dashboards operacionais Inglês avançado (B2/C1) — leitura técnica e reuniões com stakeholders globais  Como você pode se destacar?  Experiência em PMO, Delivery Management, Customer Success ou Operations em ambiente de tecnologia Familiaridade com modelos Water-Scrum-Fall ou frameworks híbridos Experiência com Power BI, Jira Analytics ou outras ferramentas de visualização Experiência com automações no Jira (regras, integrações, scripts) Familiaridade com ferramentas de IA aplicadas a produtividade (Copilot, ChatGPT, automações)  O que nós oferecemos?     Vaga remota   Contratação modelo CLT   Seu equipamento de trabalho

title: Business Analyst
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Business Analyst em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Our purpose  ecoPortal health and safety engagement software helps organisations amplify workplace safety. We give leaders the data they need to create awe-inspiring safety cultures that ignite their team’s potential. Engaged teams are the beating heart of industry-leading, odds-defying workplaces, and we’re committed to helping clients achieve that. Our mission is simple: create engaged cultures and healthier environments for all. Who are we?  We’re a true Kiwi tech success story, built from the ground up, with a vision of transforming the health and safety industry as we know it. We’re anchored by our commitment to championing people. That commitment begins from within—with our very own team. Our team culture is an organic creation built by our people, for our people. Differences are celebrated here, and we firmly believe that our diverse lived experiences work together to make us stronger as a whole. You can see more about our storyjourney here!  We create intuitive health and safety software that people want to use, giving businesses the visibility and data they need to prevent risks and build stronger, safer workplaces and safety cultures. Safety isn’t just a department, it’s a culture that involves everyone, from frontline workers to the boardroom. ecoPortal makes safety simple, visible, and shared, with an intuitive interface that people actually want to use. We help create stronger engagement, fewer incidents, and measurable improvements that drive both culture and performance. The Role  An exciting opportunity is available at ecoPortal . We are looking for a Business Analyst  to join our Project Management Office (PMO)  Team, supporting the successful implementation of our Health, Safety, Risk, and Compliance SaaS platform. You’ll play a vital role in gathering, analysing, and finalising customer requirements, ensuring that each solution is tailored to deliver value while aligning with ecoPortal’s product capabilities and delivery standards. As a Business Analyst , you’ll collaborate closely with Project Managers, Implementation Specialists , and customer stakeholders  to design fit-for-purpose solutions—ranging from minimal changes to standard templates through to complex, bespoke configurations. You'll need strong communication, analytical, and documentation skills, and an ability to work across technical and business teams to ensure clarity, alignment, and successful delivery. Key Responsibilities  Lead customer workshops and meetings to capture, validate, and finalise business requirements in line with scope. Translate customer needs into clear, technically aligned documentation using tools such as process flows, user stories, and functional specifications. Support the design of both standard and custom solutions that align with ecoPortal platform capabilities. Collaborate with internal teams (Project Managers, Implementation Specialists) to ensure smooth solution delivery. Proactively identify and flag risks or misalignments early, recommending alternative solutions where appropriate. Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) by validating builds against requirements and assisting with defect triage. Contribute to a smooth customer transition from implementation to business-as-usual (BAU) through handover documentation. Maintain a deep understanding of ecoPortal’s platform functionality to provide practical, value-driven guidance. Assist with continuous improvement initiatives, helping to refine our BA tools, templates, and methodologies.  We’re Looking for Someone Who…  Has 2+ years of Business Analyst experience , ideally within SaaS or software implementation environments. Demonstrates strong requirement gathering, analysis, and solution design  capabilities. Can confidently facilitate workshops  and work directly with customers and internal teams to define the “what” and the “why.” Is proficient in documentation practices , including process mapping, user stories, functional specs, and change logs. Understands the value of collaboration  and can work fluidly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Has exposure to project delivery methodologies  such as Agile or Hybrid models. Communicates clearly and confidently, both verbally and in writing. Is naturally curious and detail-oriented , with a drive to understand how things work and improve them. Has experience or familiarity with Health, Safety, Risk, and Compliance (HSRC)  systems – a bonus, but not required! Holds relevant certifications in Business Analysis (e.g., CBAP, CCBA ) or has equivalent experience – highly desirable.  Perks & Benefits:    37-Hour Work Week & Flexible Working: We prioritise work-life balance by offering a 37-hour workweek and flexible working arrangements. Some of your working hours will be aligned with the New Zealand time zone to ensure collaboration with the team. ⛺️ Generous Annual Leave   Birthday Perk: You get to take your birthday off! If it falls on a weekend, you can choose a day close to your birthday to celebrate. Milestone Birthdays are celebrated extra special with ecoPortal.   End-of-Year Celebration: Enter the draw for a chance to join the team at ecoPortal HQ in New Zealand for our epic end-of-year celebrations! The longer you’ve been with eP, the more entries you get. We've got flights, accommodation, and meals all covered while you’re here. ✈️  ️     Professional Development: ecoPortal offer financial assistance for Business English Language Courses, apps, or training. ❤️

Comfortable following structured workflows and confident enough to escalate when something doesn't add up. Self-motivated and persistent: you work well independently without needing close oversight. Fair compensation with performance-based raises and bonuses; Learn directly from talented, experienced leaders who are invested in your growth. Our culture  Our goal is to build a company where people feel ownership of their role and are able to grow and enrich their skills and experience. We also want to create an environment where people are challenged and encouraged to be entrepreneurial. We rely on our team to help identify and take action on initiatives that can move our business forward. Elements of our culture that can be seen in every one of our people are the following: Fall in love with problems –  We are obsessed with solving customer problems because it’s in our DNA — actively listening to customer challenges and treating them like our own. Give help generously –  We hire and nurture brilliant people who are generous with their time, skills, and perspectives. This generosity compounds across the company. Own the outcome –  Every day we make vital decisions that shape the future of our company. We hold ourselves accountable to these decisions in order to build a durable, powerful business. Take care of yourself –  Building a category-leading company is hard. It can only be achieved by encouraging and enabling our team’s mental, emotional, and physical well-being. title: Remote Mathematics Expert
description:
Empresa está contratando Remote Mathematics Expert em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

Role Overview:  We are seeking highly skilled and motivated mathematicians with a strong understanding of intermediate to advanced mathematical concepts and the ability to apply these concepts creatively to complex problems. This role is ideal for individuals who thrive in tackling challenging questions and have a passion for deep mathematical reasoning and problem-solving. We are hiring both individuals who are strong in undergraduate level mathematics and as well as those who are strong in masters/PhD level mathematics. Turing works with most of the leading LLM companies in the world today and your work will enable today’s leading LLMs to attain advanced mathematics proficiency. Key Responsibilities:  Develop and implement advanced mathematical models and computational techniques to address complex problems across diverse mathematical domains. Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams on research initiatives, providing mathematical expertise and analytical insights. Review and engage with the latest mathematical literature, including cutting-edge research papers and emerging methodologies. Apply quantitative and computational approaches to analyze data, optimize models, and support innovative problem-solving strategies. Contribute to the advancement of research projects through rigorous mathematical reasoning and technical proficiency.  Desired Skills and Qualifications:  Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD degree in Mathematics or a closely related field, with strong expertise in one or more of the following areas: computable functions and mathematical logic, algebra and number theory, linear algebra and matrix theory, topology and geometry, real analysis, probability, and statistics. Proven ability to solve complex mathematical problems, demonstrated through research experience, publications, academic achievements, or project work. Knowledge of Python and data analysis tools is preferred, though not mandatory. Excellent analytical and critical thinking skills, with strong attention to detail and problem-solving capabilities. Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex mathematical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences. Collaborative mindset with experience working in multidisciplinary teams on research-driven or project-based initiatives.  More details on required skills:  Candidates should demonstrate strong expertise in at least 4 of the following 7 domains, with broader coverage considered a significant advantage: Computable Functions and Mathematical Logic  Strong understanding of the theory of computation, computable functions, decision problems, and strategies for inferring functions from input-output relationships.  Algebra and Number Theory  Deep knowledge of algebraic structures, quadratic forms, signatures, prime numbers, Eisenstein series, and related concepts in number theory and their applications.  Linear Algebra and Matrix Theory  Proficiency in linear spaces, basis transformations, symmetric matrices, matrix equations, matrix diagonalization, and rank-related conditions.  Topology and Geometry  Understanding of vector bundles, cohomology, fundamental groups, commensurability, topological spaces, vector fields, and geometric proof techniques.  Analysis  Strong foundation in real analysis, including properties of functions almost everywhere, convergence concepts, continuity, and advanced analytical reasoning.  Probability and Statistics  Ability to apply probability theory to evaluate outcomes under varying conditions, along with experience using statistical techniques such as ANOVA for experimental and data analysis.  Applied Mathematics  Capability to apply mathematical reasoning and problem-solving techniques to practical scenarios, including logic-based and analytical challenges.  Offer Details:  Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST. Engagement type: Contractor  Evaluation Process:  Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form. After the profile review, an assessment will be shared, which must be completed within 24 hours. Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to schedule an interview.  After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.  Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Project Manager #1008790
description:

Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade. O que esperar de nós  Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco? Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade. Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento. Nosso Cliente  Estamos em busca de um profissional em projetos de TI que deverá impulsionar a excelência na execução dos projetos, manter o controle sobre escopo, cronograma e orçamento, além de assegurar entregas de alta qualidade em todas as frentes. Esta função será responsável por supervisionar a entrega ponta a ponta de quatro novos mód ulos voltados ao suporte das capacidades de Compras (Procurement), garantindo o alinhamento entre as áreas de negócio, equipes de TI e uma organização terceirizada de desenvolvimento. O candidato selecionado fará parte de um projeto global em uma empresa multinacional do setor de eletrodomést icos.  O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho:  Gestão do Programa e Supervisão das Entregas (Program & Delivery Oversight)  Será responsável pela entrega geral do roadmap dos módulos do Supplier Portal (4 subprojetos), gerenciando cronograma, orçamento, escopo e acompanhamento de marcos (milestones) em nível de programa. Também deverá manter controle rigoroso sobre a definição de escopo, gestão de mudanças e dependências entre projetos e sistemas, além de supervisionar o desempenho do Delivery Manager e da equipe terceirizada para garantir o cumprimento dos compromissos.  Governança e Comitês Executivos (Governance & Steering)  Será responsável por definir e conduzir a estrutura de governança do projeto, liderando reuniões de Comitê Executivo (SteerCo), incluindo reporte de status, gestão de riscos e escalonamentos, além dos fóruns de tomada de decisão. Também deverá fornecer visibilidade e relatórios em nível executivo, assegurando transparência sobre o andamento do programa.  Gestão de Stakeholders e Alinhamento com o Negócio (Stakeholder & Business Alignment)  Será responsável pelo relacionamento com stakeholders da área de Compras (Procurement) e com a liderança sênior, garantindo que os requisitos de negócio sejam claramente definidos, aprovados e priorizados. Deverá promover o alinhamento entre a área de Negócios (Procurement), as equipes de TI (MDR, PLM e Integração) e a organização responsável pela entrega, atuando ainda como ponto final de escalonamento para conflitos ou ambiguidades relacionadas ao negócio.  Gestão de Riscos e Problemas (Risk & Issue Management)  Deverá identificar proativamente riscos e dependências em nível de programa, garantindo que sejam mitigados de forma antecipada e sistemática. Também será responsável por escalar questões críticas com recomendações claras e análise de impacto.  Controle Financeiro e Planejamento (Financial & Planning Control)  Será responsável pelo acompanhamento e previsão orçamentária, garantindo que as entregas permaneçam dentro dos limites financeiros aprovados. Também deverá validar a alocação de recursos em conjunto com o Delivery Manager.  Liderança e Direcionamento (Leadership & Direction)  Deverá fornecer direcionamento claro e definição de prioridades ao Delivery Manager, garantindo foco em resultados, cumprimento de prazos e geração de valor para o negócio. Espera-se uma atuação proativa na resolução de ambiguidades e na remoção de impedimentos para acelerar a tomada de decisões e o progresso do programa.  O que você precisa ter:  Inglê s - Avançado (necessário para Experiência como Gerente de Projetos de TI em ambientes complexos e com múltiplas frentes de trabalho simultâneas. Experiência com metodologias ágeis de entrega (Agile). Capacidade de gerenciar equipes de desenvolvimento terceirizadas. Excelentes habilidades de gestão de stakeholders e comunicação. Forte capacidade de organização e definição de prioridades. Habilidade para atuar como ponte entre as necessidades do negócio e a entrega técnica. Perfil altamente proativo e orientado à solução de problemas. Elevada atenção aos detalhes, mantendo ao mesmo tempo uma visão estratégica e abrangente do projeto. Identificar e mitigar riscos de forma antecipada, reduzindo impactos ao programa. Entregar soluções escaláveis e de alta qualidade, alinhadas à estratégia da plataforma Supplier Portal.  Modelo de atuação:  No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office!

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Senior DevOps Engineer em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

COMO Digital Life  COMO Digital Life is a CSSF-supervised payment institution based in Luxembourg. We consolidate multi-currency accounts, payments, FX, and compliance into a single regulated platform - infrastructure that was once available only to global banks, now accessible to a broader set of organizations.  We care about doing this well. That means high reliability, genuine security, and systems built to be audited and trusted. Role Purpose  You'll join our Technology team as the engineer who owns the infrastructure backbone of a live, regulated financial platform - one that moves real money across real borders every day. This is a hands-on role. You'll design and maintain cloud-native environments, run Kubernetes in production, and keep CI/CD pipelines fast, safe, and repeatable. You'll work alongside backend engineers, security specialists, and product teams who care about code quality and operational rigour in equal measure. If tuning Kubernetes resource limits or building a Grafana dashboard that actually tells a story sounds like a good use of a Friday afternoon, you'll fit in here. What You Will Do  Infrastructure & Cloud Engineering Design, provision, and manage cloud infrastructure on AWS using Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, Bicep, or Pulumi). Build and maintain Kubernetes clusters in production. Implement container orchestration, service meshes, and network policies.  CI/CD & Automation Own CI/CD pipelines end-to-end - from commit to production - using GitHub Actions, or similar. Automate build, test, deployment, and rollback workflows. Manual steps are bugs. Apply GitOps practices and maintain versioned, auditable infrastructure changes.  Monitoring & Incident Response Build monitoring and alerting stacks using Prometheus, Grafana, ELK. Define SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets - and care about the distinction. Participate in incident response, run blameless post-mortems, and turn outages into better runbooks.  Security & Compliance  Implement secrets management, network segmentation, vulnerability scanning, and access controls. Collaborate with InfoSec to meet CSSF, PCI DSS, and data protection requirements. Treat compliance as a design constraint, not overhead.  Reliability & Performance Manage database operations, backup strategies, and disaster recovery. Optimise resource utilisation and cloud spend. Run capacity planning and load testing ahead of growth, not after.  Documentation Maintain clear, current runbooks and infrastructure documentation. If it isn't written down, it doesn't exist. Share knowledge through code reviews, pair programming, and the occasional internal tech talk.  What We're Looking For   Required  Proven experience running production infrastructure on AWS. Solid hands-on experience with Kubernetes and container orchestration. Proficiency with Infrastructure-as-Code tools — Terraform, Bicep, Pulumi, or equivalent. Experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines. Strong scripting skills in at least two of: Bash, Python, PowerShell. Working knowledge of monitoring and observability tools. Sound understanding of networking fundamentals: DNS, load balancing, firewalls, VPNs. Experience with Git and trunk-based or gitflow development workflows. Fluent spoken and written English  Nice to Have  Service mesh experience (Istio, Linkerd, or similar). Familiarity with policy-as-code frameworks (OPA, Kyverno, or equivalent). Database operations experience - PostgreSQL, Redis, or managed cloud databases. Background in a regulated industry where reliability has real consequences. Cloud certifications (AWS, CKA, or equivalent). Comfort using AI-assisted tools - GitHub Copilot, Claude, or ChatOps bots - as part of a daily engineering workflow.  How We Work  The bar here is high - for reliability, security, and auditability - because it has to be. We invest in modern tooling and good practices: infrastructure-as-code, blameless post-mortems, and documentation written before memory fades. We move with purpose, not panic. You'll receive direction from senior engineers and the CTO, but you'll own your systems. We value initiative, and we welcome a well-reasoned \"there's a better way to do this.\" How to Apply  Send your CV in English to  with the subject line “DevOps Engineer”. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted within two weeks. Recruitment Process  1.   Screening call with HR (30 min) 2. Interview with CTO and Dev Team. 3. Interview with CEO

description:

Crescemos aproximadamente 100% ao ano desde que fundamos a empresa, ganhamos por 2 anos consecutivos o Selo Dourado do CUBO Itaú e já fomos destaque em veículos como Exame e Globo. Somos 45 pessoas hoje, com meta de dobrar de receita novamente em 2026.   Sobre a vaga  Buscamos um Product Designer com domínio profundo de Figma, paixão por produto digital e capacidade de transformar problemas complexos em interfaces simples, intuitivas e bonitas. Você vai atuar na linha de frente da AutoU, tocando projetos do zero com nossos clientes enterprise, idealizando e construindo as soluções digitais que entregamos, ao mesmo tempo em que produz protótipos, apresentações e materiais visuais que sustentam tanto a entrega aos clientes quanto a expansão e a construção da marca AutoU. Mais do que entregar telas, esperamos que você ajude a elevar o nível de design da empresa como um todo, evoluindo nosso design system e construindo padrões que vão escalar com o crescimento da AutoU. Buscamos perfil de designer estruturado, com pensamento de produto, não apenas estético. Pessoas que entendem que design é resolver problema de usuário e gerar resultado de negócio, não só fazer interface bonita.   Seus principais desafios (dia a dia)  Prototipação no Figma. Construir wireframes, fluxos e protótipos navegáveis de alta fidelidade que traduzem desafios de negócio em produtos digitais reais. Entendimento de produto. Mergulhar nos processos e nas dores dos usuários dos nossos clientes para projetar interfaces que resolvem problemas reais, com foco em usabilidade e adoção. Fluxos e arquitetura de informação. Estruturar jornadas completas de usuário, fluxos de navegação e arquitetura de produtos digitais complexos do zero. Apresentações e materiais comerciais. Construir apresentações de altíssima qualidade, materiais visuais e protótipos navegáveis que sustentam propostas comerciais, diagnósticos e showcases com diretores e C-levels. Design system da AutoU. Evoluir e manter o nosso design system, criando padrões consistentes que escalam com o crescimento da empresa e dos nossos projetos. Expansão e construção da marca. Apoiar diretamente a expansão da AutoU, produzindo materiais de proposta, identidade visual de projetos e ativos que fortalecem nossa presença com clientes enterprise.   O que oferecemos  Bolsa-auxílio competitiva. R$1.800 a R$3.600/mês  de acordo com experiência prévia e portfólio, com feedbacks e promoções constantes conforme performance. Cartão benefício CAJU. R$600/mês  para apoiar nos dias presenciais. Bônus. Premiação extra atrelada a metas e resultados da empresa. Totalpass. Acesso a milhares de academias e estúdios em todo o Brasil. Day off de aniversário. 1 livro por mês. Investimos no seu desenvolvimento contínuo. Plano de carreira estruturado, com efetivação ao término da faculdade e crescimento acelerado conforme performance. Ambiente Cubo Itaú. Trabalhar dentro do maior hub de inovação da América Latina, com networking absurdo e acesso a eventos e fundadores das maiores startups do Brasil. Modelo híbrido. 2x por semana presencial na nossa sede no Cubo Itaú, Vila Olímpia. Mentoria direta. Trabalhar lado a lado com os founders da AutoU e nosso time de product designers experientes, aprendendo produto, IA e construção de negócios na prática.   Requisitos essenciais  Disponibilidade para ir 2x/semana à nossa sede na Vila Olímpia (SP Capital), além de eventos e visitas a clientes. Cursando Design, Desenho Industrial, Comunicação, Publicidade, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas em universidades de excelência (FAAP, Mackenzie, Belas Artes, ESPM, USP, Insper, PUC, dentre outras). Nos últimos 1 a 2 anos de graduação, com poucas aulas durante o horário comercial e ampla disponibilidade de tempo e dedicação ao trabalho. Domínio real de Figma. Capacidade de prototipar fluxos completos, criar componentes reutilizáveis e trabalhar com design systems.  ➕ Outros requisitos  Pensamento de produto. Entendimento real de UX, usabilidade, arquitetura de informação e jornada de usuário. Portfólio sólido com projetos de produto digital, idealmente B2B ou SaaS. Apenas projetos artísticos ou de design gráfico puro não atendem o perfil que buscamos. Capacidade comprovada de montar apresentações de altíssima qualidade e comunicar ideias com excelência. Comunicação impecável, escrita e verbal, em português. Inglês fluente é diferencial forte. Interesse e aptidão genuína por tecnologia, produto digital e Inteligência Artificial. (Diferencial não obrigatório) Experiência prévia em startups, consultorias de produto, agências digitais ou projetos de tecnologia. title: Direct-Response Ad Video Editor
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Direct-Response Ad Video Editor em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

We're looking for a direct response video editor who can produce 1-3 performance ads per day — consistently, quickly, and without hand-holding. You'll receive reference ads, raw footage, AI-generated visuals, voiceover audio, product photography, UGC clips, and creative briefs. Your job is to turn those inputs into scroll-stopping Meta ads that look native to the feed, follow direct response principles, and are ready to launch same-day. Some days you'll get a detailed brief with every asset handed to you. Other days you'll get a reference ad and a direction — and you'll need to reverse-engineer the structure, build a visual concept, and deliver a finished ad using your own creative instincts. This is not a 9-to-5 editing job. This is a performance marketing role that happens to live inside an editing timeline. What You'll Be Doing  Editing 1-3 short-form video ads per day (15-60 seconds) for Meta placements Working with a mix of UGC footage, AI-generated imagery, 3D medical-style animations, product photography, voiceover tracks, and b-roll Receiving reference ads and reverse-engineering their pacing, structure, visual rhythm, and caption systems to build VelorHealth versions Building ads from creative briefs that include scripts, shot lists, visual direction, and caption specs Originating new ad concepts when given only a direction or angle — proposing visual treatments, caption styles, and pacing without being told exactly what to do Implementing caption systems with color-coded text (white/red/blue pill captions, green keyword highlights, auto-generated TikTok-style captions) depending on the ad format Cutting multiple versions of the same ad (hook variants, length variants, aspect ratio variants) for A/B testing Maintaining a fast turnaround — most ads should go from brief to finished export within 2-4 hours Organizing and managing a growing library of raw assets, finished ads, and creative templates  What You Need  Proven experience editing direct response or performance marketing video ads (not brand content, not music videos, not wedding films — direct response ads that ran on Meta or TikTok with measurable results) Fluency in CapCut, Premiere Pro, or After Effects — whichever you're fastest in Strong understanding of Meta ad formats — you know what a native feed ad looks like versus a produced commercial, and you default to native Ability to match reference ad pacing intuitively — if we send you a competitor ad, you can deconstruct its cut timing, caption rhythm, and visual structure without being taught Comfort working with AI-generated imagery and integrating it seamlessly into live footage and product photography Experience with caption styling — you've built caption systems before (color-coded, keyword-highlighted, timed to VO) and you understand that captions are a conversion tool, not an accessibility afterthought A sharp eye for thumbnail-level scroll-stopping — you understand that the first frame of a video ad is a static image in the feed and you treat it accordingly Ability to self-manage, meet daily output targets, and communicate proactively when something is unclear or delayed Reliable internet connection and availability during US business hours (ET or CT preferred but flexible for the right person)  Bonus (Not Required)  Experience editing ads in the health, wellness, fitness, or DTC supplement space Familiarity with the \"ugly ad\" aesthetic — ads intentionally designed to look like organic UGC rather than polished production Experience with motion graphics or basic After Effects animation (for text overlays, simple transitions, or kinetic typography) Understanding of direct response copywriting principles (you know why a hook matters, why the product should appear early, why the CTA needs to sound like a peer recommendation)  What You Don't Need  A film degree A fancy reel of cinematic work Experience at a big agency Color grading expertise  We care about speed, instinct, and output quality at volume. If your best work is a single beautifully-graded 3-minute brand film, this isn't the right fit. If your best work is 47 Meta ads you cut last month that all drove profitable ROAS, we want to talk to you. Compensation  Competitive rate based on experience. This is a contract role with potential to grow into a long-term position as the brand scales. We value speed and consistency — editors who hit daily output targets reliably will have no shortage of work. How To Apply  There will be a paid test before any hire is made. Here's how it works: Apply with your portfolio.  Send 3-5 examples of direct response video ads you've edited that actually ran on Meta or TikTok. Tell us the niche, the objective, and the result if you have it. We don't need a sizzle reel — we need proof you've done this before. If your portfolio fits, we'll send you a paid test project.  You'll receive a reference ad, a script, raw assets (footage, images, voiceover), and a creative brief. You'll have 24 hours to deliver a finished ad. This test is paid regardless of whether you're hired.  We evaluate the test on four criteria:  Did you match the pacing and structure of the reference? Did the first frame stop the scroll? Did the captions and visual rhythm support the VO? Did you deliver on time?  If the test passes, you start with a one-week trial  at 1 ad per day. If that week goes well, we scale to full output.  We're not looking for perfection. We're looking for someone who ships fast, learns from references quickly, and gets better with every ad they cut. To apply, send your portfolio and a brief note about your direct response editing experience to (your email) with the subject line \"DR Editor — (Your Name).\"

Requisitos e qualificações  • Formação em Técnico, Tecnólogo ou Engenheiro de Automação, Mecatrônica, Elétrica, Mecânica ou áreas correlatas; • Mínimo de 2 anos de experiência em automação industrial; • Experiência com projeto e integração de máquinas especiais; • Programação de PLCs (Siemens, Rockwell ou similares); • Conhecimento em sistemas de visão/imagem industrial; • Experiência com servoacionamentos, motion control e integração de sistemas robóticos industriais; • Conhecimento ou experiência com aplicações de robótica industrial (ABB, FANUC, KUKA, Yaskawa, Universal Robots ou similares) será considerado diferencial; • Leitura e elaboração de diagramas elétricos e pneumáticos; • Vivência em comissionamento e troubleshooting; • Conhecimento em documentação técnica de validação; • Desejável experiência em ambientes regulados (dispositivos médicos, farmacêutico ou correlatos); • Conhecimento em GAMP 5 e processos de validação (IQ/OQ/PQ) será considerado diferencial; • Conhecimento em aplicações de Inteligência Artificial voltadas à automação industrial será considerado diferencial. Imprescindível Residir em Campinas ou Sumaré, Paulínia, Hortolândia, Monte Mor, Valinhos.  Competências comportamentais  • Pensamento analítico e sistêmico; • Forte capacidade de resolução de problemas; • Organização e disciplina na gestão documental; • Comunicação clara com times multidisciplinares (Qualidade, Regulatório e Produção); • Perfil hands-on, com foco em resultados; • Senso de responsabilidade técnica; • Capacidade de atuar em ambiente regulado e auditável. OFERECEMOS • Participação em projetos estratégicos de automação industrial; • Ambiente técnico desafiador e inovador; • Contato com tecnologias aplicadas à manufatura de dispositivos médicos; • Oportunidade de desenvolvimento técnico e crescimento profissional. Benefícios:  Vale Alimentação; Vale Refeição; Vale transporte ou auxílio combustível; Convênio médico Unimed ou SulAmérica coparticipativo para colaboradores (opcional); Convênio odontológico para colaboradores e dependentes (opcional); Parceria com a faculdade Esamc, desconto nas mensalidades de Graduações, Tecnólogos e MBA; Seguro de vida.
